tagline: All-in-One Mobile Field Management for Solo Contractors & Independent Specialists

posts.title: All-in-One Field Management for Solo Contractors
posts.objective: Introduce SoloTrak as the ultimate single-user contractor app.
posts.caption: Run your entire business from your pocket. SoloTrak combines job dispatch, client invoicing, time tracking, and receipt scanning into one sleek app built for solo pros.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Solo electrician in clean work gear holding smartphone showing SoloTrak mobile dashboard next to work van.

posts.title: Automated Geofenced Clock-In & Out
posts.caption: Arrive at the jobsite and start logging time automatically. SoloTrak detects when you enter the customer's property line so you never forget to log billable hours.

visual_spec.topic_visual: GPS map location pin dropped on residential service location with 'Auto-Clock In Active' notification banner.

posts.title: Instant Mobile Invoicing & Digital Estimates
posts.objective: Showcase fast on-site invoicing and instant payments.
posts.caption: Get paid before you leave the driveway. Generate professional estimates and invoices directly on your phone and email them to clients in seconds with SoloTrak.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Clean mobile invoice interface with 'Send to Client' green button and total cost breakdown.

posts.title: Mobile Receipt AI Scanner & Tax Expense Tracking
posts.objective: Highlight AI receipt scanning for tax deductible expenses.
posts.caption: Stop losing supply store receipts in your truck console. Scan receipts instantly with SoloTrak AI to categorize material expenses for tax time.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Receipt image being processed by mobile scanner with extracted totals and job association.

posts.title: Equipment & Tool QR Tagging
posts.objective: Showcase QR tool tagging for solo pros.
posts.caption: Keep track of specialized diagnostic tools and equipment across client sites. Tag tools with QR codes and scan with SoloTrak to know where everything is.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Durable tool case with QR code badge being scanned by mobile app camera.

posts.title: Offline-First Sync for Remote Jobsites
posts.objective: Promote full functionality in zero-cell-service zones.
posts.caption: Working in a basement or remote location with no signal? SoloTrak works 100% offline and automatically syncs all logs once connectivity is restored.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Remote jobsite scene with 'Offline Sync Queue' indicator badge showing active offline data storage.

posts.title: Client Communication & Photo Proof of Work
posts.objective: Highlight before/after photo uploads and work proof.
posts.caption: Build bulletproof trust with property owners. Attach before and after site photos directly to customer service records in SoloTrak.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Side-by-side before and after repair photos displayed within a sleek customer report template.

posts.title: Vehicle Mileage & Travel Expense Tracking
posts.objective: Promote mileage tracking for tax write-offs.
posts.caption: Don't leave thousands in vehicle mileage tax deductions on the table. Track trip miles between service calls effortlessly with SoloTrak.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Digital odometer mileage tracker interface displaying route map and calculated mileage expense.

posts.title: Zero Office Bloat – Pure Contractor Utility
posts.objective: Emphasize simplicity and lack of cumbersome desktop software.
posts.caption: No complicated menus or bulky office setups. SoloTrak is engineered specifically for hands-on trade pros who want fast, simple software that just works.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Clean high-contrast mobile app interface showing single-tap buttons for Clock In, Scan, and Invoice.

posts.title: One-Tap E-Signatures for Work Orders
posts.caption: Get client approval immediately upon job completion. Capture digital signatures on your phone and automatically email signed work receipts.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Customer signing mobile touchscreen with digital stylus and verified timestamp badge.
